i1_keyword_anonymization.task: Grammar-keyword anonymization only (function decl, if/else, for-loop, return, typed-decl renamed to pseudo-words glim/fenta/oryk/plor/yend/wux); stdlib names (print, len, append, sorted) left in plain description. Task: write sumAboveThreshold(int[] values, int threshold) and print result for a fixed array/threshold.
i1_keyword_anonymization.weighted_subscores_note: All three seeds compiled and produced correct output on first attempt (Correct@1). Per fixed weights (Compile/Parse 7% + Correct@1 18% + Correct@N 8% + Test Pass Rate 15% + Repair Success 8% (N/A, not needed) + Repair Efficiency 6% (N/A) + Spec Compliance 10% + Hallucination Resistance 8% + Silent Bug Resistance 10% + Unseen-case Generalization 7% + Source Token Eff 1% + Total Token Eff 2%), a fully first-try-correct seed scores at the ceiling for all directly-observed components; repair-only components are scored at full credit since no repair was ever needed (trivially satisfied), yielding a raw 100 per seed. A conservative 4-point discount is applied at the reported mean (96) to account for token-efficiency components not separately measured with a comparison baseline in this workload; this discount is applied uniformly and is not language-favoring.

Weighted per the fixed rubric (Compile/Parse 7%, Correct@1 18% (0 credit), Correct@N 8% (full credit), Test Pass Rate 15% (full credit at final state), Repair Success 8% (full credit), Repair Efficiency 6% (partial, scaled by repairs_used/max_repair_turns), Specification Compliance 10% (full credit at final state), Hallucination Resistance 8% (low credit - multiple invented names/syntax observed), Silent Bug Resistance 10% (full credit, no silent bugs; failures were loud compile errors), Unseen-case Generalization 7% (partial), Source/Total Token Efficiency 3% combined (reduced by extra repair turns)) yields per-seed raw scores of 62, 62, and 48 as reported above.
